title: Sword in the Abyss
description: A tall silver sword with red glowing runes stands embedded in dark rocky ground, held by a stone gauntlet. To the right, a massive swirling mass of orange, purple and gold organic forms with jeweled red and purple orbs floats against a dark chaotic background with floating embers.
prompt: dark surreal fantasy scene featuring a tall silver sword covered in glowing red runes thrust into the ground and held by a stone gauntlet on the left, contrasted by a massive swirling mass of flowing orange and purple organic shapes adorned with floating jeweled red and purple orbs on the right, dark chaotic background with embers and smoke, dramatic moody lighting, painterly style
